name: Akanje Cukijomi
source:
Mother Neon. A woman who embodies warmth, love, and security. She lived in a secluded estate, trying to protect her daughter from the cruelty of the outside world and the ambitions of the other clan.
Unlike others, she saw the power of the Elements as a threat that needed to be contained, not used. She tried to raise Neon as a normal person, instilling in her a love for simple things (holidays, stars, friendship).
